# Testimoni

> Testimoni is a testimonial widget for founders, coaches, agencies, and D2C brands. Paste any X or LinkedIn URL and get an approved testimonial in 30 seconds — no screenshots, no copy-paste. Or share a link, form, or QR code to collect fresh testimonials. Every workspace gets a public Wall of Love URL and a one-line JavaScript embed on day one.

## What Testimoni is

Testimoni turns customer praise into social proof you can put anywhere. Three-step loop:

- **Ask** — Send one link (email, WhatsApp, DM, QR, or a widget on your site) to your happiest customers.
- **Collect** — Text, star ratings, and video (1 free on every plan) land in one approval inbox.
- **Publish** — One line of JavaScript embeds a Wall of Love on your site. Every workspace also gets a free hosted URL: `testimoni.io/w/<workspace-id>`.

Site: https://testimoni.io

## Pricing

- **Free forever**: 10 testimonials, 1 collection form, 1 widget, 1 video testimonial, hosted Wall of Love URL, one-line embed, grid layout. No credit card.
- **Pro — $9/month (₹499 for India)**: Unlimited testimonials, forms, widgets, and video. All 5 layouts (Grid, Masonry, Carousel, List, Marquee). Custom branding. Remove "Powered by" watermark. Import from Twitter/LinkedIn. Analytics dashboard. Priority support.

Native INR billing through Razorpay for Indian customers.

## Comparison

Testimoni vs the incumbents:

- **vs Senja** — Free hosted Wall of Love (Senja gates it), auto-add on approve, Pro at half the price. See [/vs/senja](https://testimoni.io/vs/senja).
- **vs Testimonial.to** — Paste-a-tweet URL import (Testimonial.to has none), free hosted wall, Pro at one-fifth the price. See [/vs/testimonial-to](https://testimoni.io/vs/testimonial-to).

## Who Testimoni is for

- SaaS founders wanting a testimonial wall live in 30 seconds
- Coaches and creators building social proof from happy replies
- Agencies collecting client feedback for case studies
- D2C brands running QR-code testimonial collection on packaging
- Solo indie hackers who don't want to code a wall from scratch

## Key features

- **Paste-a-tweet import** — X and LinkedIn URLs pull the author, avatar, text, and star rating automatically
- **Collection forms** — public forms shareable via link, embed, iframe, email, or QR code
- **Video testimonials** — MP4/MOV upload; 1 free on every plan
- **Approval inbox** — one-click approve; approved testimonials flow to the Wall of Love instantly
- **5 layouts** — Grid, Masonry, Carousel, List, Marquee
- **One-line embed** — sub-10KB, Shadow-DOM isolated, no CSS conflicts with your site (Framer, Webflow, WordPress, React, plain HTML)
- **Hosted Wall of Love URL** — free public page on every plan
- **Multi-currency pricing** — USD ($9) or INR (₹499)
- **Auto-generated share tools** — QR code, email template, DM template
